headline.zh:
Agent 少做了什么
一眼就能分辨
headline.en:
See exactly what
your agent skipped

sub.zh: 当编码 Agent 刻意省略一项，当场记下它跳过了什么、为什么——把合理省略和偷工减料变成可查、可重做的记录。
sub.en: The instant your coding agent deliberately skips something, OmitLedger records what was omitted and why — turning justified laziness into a queryable, re-requestable record you can tell apart from a silently cut corner.

body.zh: Agent 决定跳过的那一刻就记下事项、理由与目标文件——不用等它写完再回头猜它漏了什么。
body.en: The moment an agent decides to skip, the item, its stated reason, and target file are captured — no diffing output against a mental model of 'complete' afterwards.

chips: › 一段 agent skill 让它主动上报

title.zh: 合理省略 vs 偷工减料

body.zh: 每条省略都带 Agent 自述的理由，一本可查的台账让你分辨它究竟是审慎最小化还是偷偷砍角。
body.en: Each omission carries the agent's own stated reason, in a queryable ledger that tells apart prudent minimization from a quietly cut corner.

title.en: Reopen the one that looks off

body.zh: 看到不靠谱的省略，一条命令标回「需要重做」，下个会话重新注入——不必全盘推翻整次运行。
body.en: Spot an omission that looks off, mark it back to 'needs redo', and it's re-injected into the next session — no need to throw out the whole run.

headline.zh: 让 Agent 的省略留下记录
headline.en: Make your agent's omissions leave a trace

sub.zh: 一个二进制，一个本地文件，零云端。MIT 开源。
sub.en: One binary, one local file, zero cloud. MIT-licensed open source.
